budget_items.topic: PACC operating income and enterprise fund
budget_items.what_was_recorded: PACC expects Comcast income that its operations will not exceed, and any surplus goes to an enterprise fund projected to reach a stated balance by the end of FY23.

budget_items.topic: Sewer retained earnings transfer for FY24
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The sewer commission would need to transfer a stated sum out of retained earnings to fund the FY24 operating budget, for pump station upgrades, debt service and capital expenses.
